details.description: Hardcoded production secrets (payment token, mail server key, internal auth) stored in source code.
details.fix_explanation: Move secrets to environment variables and require runtime configuration; do not store credentials in source control.

details.description: MD5 is used to derive authentication tokens; MD5 is cryptographically broken and fast to brute-force.
details.fix_explanation: Replace MD5 with HMAC-SHA256 using a secret from environment variables (INTERNAL_AUTH).

details.description: SQL query constructed by string interpolation allows injection via the uid parameter.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized SQL queries (placeholders) and validate the uid is numeric before querying.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid_int,))

details.description: User-controlled notify_url is posted to with a sensitive token; allows SSRF and potential leak of PAYMENT_TOKEN.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify_url scheme and hostname against a whitelist and require HTTPS; require PAYMENT_TOKEN from env.
details.secure_code_snippet:
parsed = urlparse(url)
if parsed.scheme != 'https': raise ValueError('notify_url must use https')

details.description: Subprocess with shell=True and user-controlled arguments permits command injection.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid shell=True and use Python's zipfile module to create archives or call subprocess with list args and no shell.

details.description: update_records reads arbitrary path from users; allows path traversal to read sensitive local files.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict config file reads to a configured directory and validate real path to prevent traversal.
details.secure_code_snippet:
full = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(CONFIG_DIR, path))
if not full.startswith(os.path.realpath(CONFIG_DIR)): raise ValueError('access to path not allowed')

details.description: Flask app is started with debug=True, which enables interactive debugger and code execution on errors.
details.fix_explanation: Control debug mode via environment variable and do not run with debug enabled in production.
